english.homograph_exclusion: The adjective light meaning 'not heavy' belongs to a different historical root and is outside this record.

extended_meanings: music or sound, especially in 天籁 and 万籁

observed_relation.phonetic: The modern forms share an approximate /laɪ/ sequence; English has final /t/, while Mandarin has a lexical falling tone and no final /t/.
observed_relation.direct_lexical_semantics: weak: light denotes illumination; 籁 historically denotes an instrument and then sound
observed_relation.historical_cognacy: unsupported; no historical common-origin or borrowing evidence has been identified

promotion_blockers: No preregistered behavioral evidence for a sound-symbolic or cross-modal association.
The motivating European positive forms collapse to one PIE family at the deepest deduplication level.
author: Jinkai Liu｜劉金凱
publication_note: The Language Book entry and literary work are published. The light → 籁 mapping remains Candidate / retain_without_promotion.
